root_cause: The existing hourly revenue learning evaluator iterated every due evidence item from a 150-row store page without a bounded, per-channel fair batch. It also allowed INFERRED source evidence and mixed unverified cohorts into candidate evaluation, even though actual paid outcomes, qualified buyer replies and provider evidence were absent.

observed_evidence.source: Production: revenue_learning_evidence 143 rows, 107 INFERRED website records; only 3 historical applications across social/revenue; 2026-10-25 cross-channel obligations live-proven but measured/learned timestamps absent; revenue-intelligence degraded.

fix: Reuse existing Netlify @hourly evaluator. Bound to eight due windows, rotate channel priority fairly, accept only OBSERVED/PROVIDER_OBSERVED source-backed targets and cohorts, record typed obligation rather than promote inferred evidence, summarize valid progress, return 503 for runtime failures.
prevention_rules: Separate evidence collection/obligation recording from PROVEN optimization and paid-order evidence.
Limit each hourly evaluation, rotate channels and preserve stale queue visibility; no unbounded retries.
Verify target and cohort sourceRefs and observed data quality before calculating advantage.
Never count prediction, generated copy, lead suggestion, or inferred site visit as a paid order.
Re-use canonical scheduler, stores, shared Brain error memory and existing CI; do not add sender, cron or revenue counter.
terminal_rule: Exact-head Required and CodeQL, protected merge and Netlify deployment/readback; actual next hourly run must show bounded summary and real source-linked promotion if qualified, followed by independent attributed customer/order evidence.
